en.headline: Car collides with road works vehicle on Gascoigne Road in Yau Ma Tei
en.dek: A white private car struck the rear of a road works vehicle early on Wednesday morning; the driver sustained abrasions and was treated at the scene.
body: Police and firefighters responded to a collision on Gascoigne Road in Yau Ma Tei at about 5am on Wednesday after reports that someone might be trapped.

A white Lexus private car had crashed into the right rear section of a road works vehicle that was straddling part of a traffic lane. The car suffered severe front-end damage, with the bumper and other parts scattered and the windscreen cracked. The works vehicle also showed collision marks on its rear.

Rescuers confirmed no one was trapped. The car driver suffered abrasions and was treated at the scene. Police cordoned off part of the lane, spoke to the drivers and later towed both vehicles away while investigating the cause of the crash.

zh.headline: 油麻地加士居道私家車撞工程車 司機擦傷現場治理
zh.dek: 周三凌晨約5時，一輚白色私家車撞向工程車車尾，司機受擦傷並在現場接受治療，警方正調查成因。
body: 警方及消防人員周三凌晨約5時接報，油麻地加士居道發生交通意外，初步有指有人被困。
一輚白色凌志私家車撞向一輚跨佔部分行車線的工程車右後方。私家車車頭嚴重損毀，保險槓及其他零件散落路面，擋風玻璃破裂；工程車車尾亦有碰撞痕跡。
救援人員到場後確認無人被困。私家車司機受擦傷，在現場接受治理。警方封鎖部分行車線進行調查，向司機了解情況，其後將兩車拖離現場，正調查意外成因。
